CustomField.description: The share of this meter consumption attributed to this space. Rolls up into Meter.Total Allocated Percent so an incomplete or double counted split is visible on the meter itself.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter 25 for a quarter share, not 0.25. The shares on one meter would normally add up to 100; check Total Allocated Percent on the meter after editing.
CustomField.label: Allocation Percent
